name: service-operations

documents.name: architecture.txt
documents.text: The daemon is the only SQLite writer. The gateway communicates with it over HTTP. Vectorization drains from an asynchronous outbox.

documents.name: operations.txt
documents.text: The daemon binds to 127.0.0.1 by default. Graph enrichment can be retried with reminisce after a restart. Profile names normally derive from the git remote.

expectedFacts: daemon is the only SQLite writer
gateway communicates with it over HTTP
vectorization drains from an asynchronous outbox
graph enrichment can be retried with reminisce
profile names derive from the git remote

name: full-project-primer

documents.name: modules.txt
documents.text: Pieria has daemon, gateway, shared, CLI, and eval modules. The daemon owns persistence and models. Shared defines HTTP contracts. Eval runs live quality benchmarks.

documents.name: ingestion.txt
documents.text: Ingestion normalizes and stores raw messages before extraction. Verified memories are stored incrementally and queued for embeddings. Ordinary transcript ingestion enriches graphs synchronously.

documents.name: onboarding.txt
documents.text: Onboarding processes sources sequentially in request order. Core readiness does not wait for embeddings. Automatic graph enrichment only targets onboarding sessions and runs as a child task.

documents.name: recovery.txt
documents.text: Ledger checkpoints are written only after a document batch is durable. Failed core onboarding does not start graph enrichment. Orphan rows survive daemon restarts and remain retryable.

expectedFacts: core readiness does not wait for embeddings
graph enrichment runs as a child task
ledger checkpoints after a document batch is durable
failed core onboarding does not start graph enrichment

recalls.query: When is an onboarding ledger checkpoint written?
expectedEvidence: after a document batch is durable
